entries.summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security reported October 13 talks in Hanoi between Deputy Minister Nguyen Van Long and Russian Federal Penitentiary Service director Arkady Gostev. It says the agencies signed a cooperation programme for 2026–2028 concerning criminal sentence enforcement and discussed training, detention management and information exchange. The account does not demonstrate that the future activities have occurred.
caveats: A cooperation programme for 2026–2028 was reportedly signed on October 13; distinguish it from the earlier October 2025 memorandum, and do not describe all planned activities as implemented.
The Russian counterpart was the Federal Penitentiary Service, not the Russian defence ministry or military; neither procurement nor military deployment is established.
This is the Vietnamese public-security ministry's account. The original is captured privately; this independently written synopsis is not approval to republish source text, images or translations.

entries.summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security reported an October 13 meeting between Deputy Minister Le Van Tuyen and a Chinese vice minister of justice during National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man's October 11–15 China visit. The ministry framed the talks as part of bilateral legal and public-security cooperation; the available account does not by itself establish a military agreement or completed enforcement operation.
caveats: The October 11–15 dates describe the broader parliamentary visit, not a completed series of new bilateral public-security actions.
Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security and China's Ministry of Justice are the institutions involved; do not mislabel the discussion a defence-ministry meeting.
Treat reported ambitions for future cooperation as intentions unless a separately documented agreement or action is verified; no publisher body or media are reproduced.
